adaptation_notes: The cases are original synthetic data informed by public evaluation methods; no external benchmark payload is copied.
Reviewed cases define executable project oracles but do not claim that OpenBridge, any model, or any Provider passed them.
The null ref is intentional because this is project-design provenance for the current corpus release, not an external immutable source snapshot.
observed_facts: OpenBridge separates deterministic wire and gateway semantics from explicitly approved live model-quality experiments.
The project contract requires a future protocol-specific runner to normalize Chat and Responses outputs into one semantic trace before oracle evaluation.
Synthetic context cases vary generated UTF-8 bytes and relevant-fact placement; real input token counts remain runtime evidence rather than corpus metadata.
Default corpus tooling remains credential-free and does not start OpenBridge or call a Provider.
